root_cause: Canonical assets ≈ 2× V7 raw due to EXTERNAL_ID SCHEME CHANGE + normalize without migration filter. Pre-V3 imports used text external_id (identificador/BRK, e.g. G4-6, BRK-005) with last_migration_id NULL. V7 uses numeric legacy id (e.g. 7). Same logical asset → two broki_assets rows (same identifier, different external_id). broki_normalize_assets() upserts ALL rows for source_table in (inventario,furgonetas,gse) without filtering last_migration_id, so both survive and both get updated_at on each normalize. public__* mirrors are RAW_ONLY and are NOT the ×2 driver.
